parsed.public_message: Blue anchors the west-center line at (650,644) with GPT set to enemy. Our elephants screen the center while our archers pour fire into Green's pocket at (696,639) alongside Orange from the south and White from the north. Neutral to Orange and White.

private_messages.Claude: Green's melee screen is gone: we see 27 Cretan archers, 6 skirmishers, 1 towered elephant, 1 spearman, 1 surgeon, and Ptolemy at (696,639). Our 3 champion elephants are screening at (650,644) and all 10 archers are firing into Green's west face from (646,644) as your infantry closes from the south.
private_messages.Grok: Green is down to 27 Cretan archers, 6 skirmishers, 1 towered elephant, 1 spearman, 1 surgeon, and Ptolemy at (696,639). Our elephants and 10 archers are firing into their west face from (646,644) while Orange's 60 units close from (649,608). Keep Alexander and your archers alive at range while Orange's infantry absorbs their fire.

parsed.notes_to_self: Turn 18 (t=525s, 50s turn to t=575s): Grok lost his melee screen charging GPT in t=500-525 (down to 9 units + Alexander at 75% HP at 661,658), but also wiped GPT's melee screen (GPT has 27 Cretan archers, 6 skirmishers, 1 spearman, 1 towered elephant, 1 surgeon, Ptolemy at 696,639). Claude has 59 units + Hannibal at 100% HP at (649,608) charging GPT. We hold dead-center (640,644) on standground with elephants in front at (650,644), archers firing into GPT from (646,644) (50m range to 696,639), swordsmen on flanks (645,650 and 645,638), companions reserve (638,652), Seleucus aura at (640,644), surgeons guarding elephants. This lets our archers deal free damage while Claude tanks GPT's 33 ranged units and elephant for 50s, preserving our 100% HP army on the 90m ring center for the endgame vs Claude.
parsed.explanation: Grok's early charge eliminated GPT's melee screen at the cost of his own front line, leaving Claude's 60-unit melee army right on GPT's southern doorstep for this 50-second turn. Rather than rushing our melee units into GPT's 27 Cretan archers and towered elephant to tank for Claude, we lock our formation onto the exact map center on stand-ground with our 3 Champion Elephants screening in front and all 10 archers firing into GPT's pocket from 50 metres away. This contributes ranged fire to finish off GPT while forcing Claude's unshielded infantry to absorb the brunt of GPT's ranged damage before the final showdown.
